title: Item Drops
description: Modify the appearance of dropped items and blocks.
body: Modify the appearance of dropped items and blocks. ![Demo Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FvCNWcm8/images/a715055c508afdbfa2f1fcc63434113be51bbdde.webp) ![Config Options Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/FvCNWcm8/images/faac8cb2dc73b61f25c860cfe45d70a3b3117fcd.webp) ### Issues You can submit issues on [Github](https://github.com/SoundsoftheSun/item-drops/issues) or [Codeberg](https://codeberg.org/SoundsoftheSun/Item-Drops/issues) ### Translation Most of my downloads come from countries where English is not the primary language! If you want to help translate any of my mods to your language, you can go to https://translate.soundsofthesun.net/projects and sign in with github to contribute! Translation Credits: |Language|Contributor| |---|---| |Simplified Chinese|LinLei_Baruch| |Arabic|Amir| More translation history can be found on the i18n branch of the source repository.
